1879116096.name: War-cry
1879116096.desc: A shout which deals Light Damage to a group of enemies around the Warden.

1879160000.desc: A horse from the Fall Festival.

1879210816.desc: A fire tipped arrow which will continue to burn the target after landing.

1879212096.name: Candle and Mirror
1879212096.desc: Using a candle, a mirror, a right angle, and some alcohol (for the victim) the illusion of a ghost can be created around the target.

1879213888.name: Surgical Strike (Ranged)
1879213888.desc: Your Fellowship strikes at Draigoch's front left leg, reducing its ability to resist damage.

1879215040.name: Good Map to Isendeep
1879215040.desc: A well drawn and detailed map to Isendeep.

1879218624.name: Soliloquy of My Spirit
1879218624.desc: Your tune is like a slow burning Soliloquy that keeps your spirit bolstered for a time. This is one of the few minstrel morale heals that can be used on the move.

1879227840.name: Ring of Frost
1879227840.desc: Harness the power of Frost to provide a powerful defensive boon to an ally without a ring.

1879244864.name: Defence of the Eorlingas
1879244864.desc: You focus on defence, increasing your War-steed's agility and armour.\n\n<rgb=#66ffff>Applies the Shield effect to you. Skill of the Eorlingas becomes Shield the Flank.</rgb>

1879245632.name: Resolution of Enduring Life
1879245632.desc: In the end, everything comes to resolution. Some may not enjoy the final result.

1879247808.name: Destabilizing Strike
1879247808.desc: You call upon your inner reserve of strength to unnerve your opposition, forcing them to behave as you desire on the field of battle.

1879248320.name: Ballad - Chant
1879248320.desc: A chant can be a powerful force of restoring courage upon the field of battle.

1879300416.name: Standard of War
1879300416.desc: Calls forth the Standard of War, dealing damage to enemies while enhancing the attacks of nearby allies.

1879302592.name: Call to Arms: Herald of Hope (Defender)
1879302592.desc: You enlist a Herald to carry your Banner of Hope into battle. This banner increases the mitigations of those around it.

1879338176.name: Return to after-battle Minas Tirith
1879338176.desc: Thanks to your friendship with the Defenders of Minas Tirith, you're able to quickly return to the gate of after-battle Minas Tirith. This skill is easily interrupted.

1879341376.name: Steed of the North Ithilien Wilds

1879362240.name: Winter Elk
1879362240.desc: An Elk from the Yule Festival.

1879411392.name: Dextrous Hook
1879411392.desc: A quick hook that generates Mettle.\n\nDextrous Set-up: If a Dextrous Hook is the most recent Set-up Attack used, the next Mettle Spender will deal 35% additional skill damage.

1879449408.name: Noble Starling
1879449408.desc: Summons a beautiful starling to accompany you on your journeys.

1879451328.name: Boon of the Battle-scarred
1879451328.desc: Douse your ally with a foul concoction, corrupting their many scars and reminding them that they need not fear the weapons of the enemy.

1879452480.name: Elk of Flowing Silver
1879452480.desc: A steed that moves like a river of melted silver.

1879466432.name: Bastion of Light
1879466432.desc: Your connexion to the Light manifests beneath your feet; marking targets within the light making them susceptible to your debuffs.

1879476160.name: Sail to Jax Phanâl
1879476160.desc: Navigate to Jax Phanâl on the Cape of Umbar with nearby fellows.

1879489216.name: Unbreakable Bond
1879489216.desc: Draw upon the bond you share with your animal companion, redirecting your healing to your companion while redirecting their incoming Damage from Morale to Power.

1879492160.name: Marching Orders
1879492160.desc: Command your war-band to move defensively, hardening the corruption in their flesh into a shield against the enemy.

1879506624.name: Prepared: Shadow Breath
1879506624.desc: Using fell knowledge and potions, breathe a gout of living shadow upon your foes.

1879516736.name: Drop Yellow Mushroom
1879516736.desc: Drop your current mushroom.\n\n<rgb=#00ff00>The mushroom will explode when dropped.</rgb>

1879532352.name: Scout Strikes
1879532352.desc: You steady your aim, increasing the Critical Hit chance of your skills by 100% for your next three critical hits.
